digest.component_or_area: automated bug filing and canary alert system
propositions: Three automated bug filers (heartbeat-alert, binding-drift-alert, conflict-bug-ticket) lack dedup logic and file duplicates on flakes or state changes without stable tags or templates.

Heartbeat-alert filer needs 2-consecutive-red threshold via workflow run-history query to avoid filing single transient failures, with dedup via stable per-check tag and <=1 accumulation comment per 24h.

Binding-drift-alert filer should use dedup tag and accumulation-per-24h without a consecutive-red threshold, because drift is persistent state that cannot self-heal and auto-close on green is already implemented.

Conflict-bug-ticket filer in applier.py requires per-conflict dedup tag (derived from local-id + jira-key), templated body, abort-if-empty-detail, and detected_by stamp, with no auto-close (requires adjudication).
All three filers must implement abort-if-empty-detail with loud logging and exit code, and all must stamp detected_by environment variable per the bug-creation contract.
Bug-creation contract must document exact rebar create args, exit codes, dedup search command, and run-history query recipe so future filers are well-formed and consistent.
